description: This file contains utility functions for loading and managing test projects, test files, suites, and related configurations in the Playwright test runner. It handles project and test file collection, test suite creation, filtering, sharding, and source map support.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used to organize and run tests.

methods.name: collectProjectsAndTestFiles
methods.description: Collects project and test files based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: loadFileSuites
methods.description: Loads test suites from test files, handling dependencies and errors.

methods.name: createRootSuite
methods.description: Creates the root test suite, applying filtering, sharding, and 'only' semantics.

methods.name: loadGlobalHook
methods.description: Loads a global setup hook from a specified file.

methods.name: loadReporter
methods.description: Loads a reporter module from a specified file.

methods.name: loadTestList
methods.description: Loads a list of tests from a file for filtering purposes.
